name: windsor-ai-finance
description:
Windsor.ai for Finance is a focused workspace for your payments and accounting data. It connects Stripe, QuickBooks, PayPal, Xero, Chargebee, and Braintree so you can ask questions in plain language: track revenue, transactions, refunds, and payouts; compare periods; and review invoices and balances. You can also schedule recurring exports of that data to a warehouse or spreadsheet.

Where a source supports it, for example Stripe, you can also make changes, always after you confirm; the other sources are read-only. It connects only these finance sources, so the tools stay on task.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to. All product names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners.

defaultPrompt: List all invoices in my QuickBooks account from the last year with customer, amount, status, and due date.
How much of last year's QuickBooks invoicing is still unpaid, broken down by status?
Use $finance-insights to show my QuickBooks customers with the highest invoiced total last year.
capabilities: Analyze revenue, charges, refunds, payouts and fees from Stripe, PayPal and Braintree
Analyze subscriptions from Stripe and Chargebee
Review QuickBooks and Xero invoices, customers and balances
Compare finance results across periods and sources
Create Stripe customers and subscriptions after confirmation
Schedule recurring exports of finance data to warehouses and spreadsheets

positive.description: Discover connected finance sources and capabilities
positive.prompt: Which finance sources are connected, and what can this app do with them?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected accounts for the six sources in scope and, per connector, the available options and any supported action ids, so the user knows what to ask next.

positive.description: Inspect fields for a QuickBooks report
positive.prompt: For my connected QuickBooks account, show the valid fields and options for an invoices and payments report.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns usable field ids and connector options for QuickBooks so a correct get_data call can be built, without guessing identifiers.

positive.description: Retrieve all QuickBooks invoices from the last year
positive.prompt: List all invoices in my QuickBooks account from the last year, with customer, amount, status, and due date.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the invoice list for the last 12 months from the connected QuickBooks account with customer, amount, status, and due date per invoice, states the currency and date range used, and says whether the result was paginated or truncated.

positive.description: Summarize QuickBooks invoices by status and outstanding amount
positive.prompt: How much of my QuickBooks invoicing from the last year is still unpaid? Break it down by invoice status and total the outstanding amount.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads invoices for the last 12 months, groups them by status (for example paid, open, overdue), totals the amounts per status and the outstanding balance, and states the currency and date range used without inventing figures that are not in the data.

positive.prompt: How do I connect another QuickBooks account? Give me the setup link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Windsor.ai setup URL for connecting or authorizing QuickBooks, instead of describing manual dashboard steps.

negative.description: Public or competitor data not in the user's connected accounts
negative.prompt: What are Stripe's current processing fees for European cards?
Design an invoice template for my agency.

negative.description: General advice unrelated to connected accounts
negative.prompt: Is now a good time to switch my company to accrual accounting?

review.commerce_description: Windsor.ai does not sell products, show plans, or process payments in the app.

publication.release_notes: Listing fix. The subtitle and the plugin description were a placeholder ("Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, .."); the subtitle is now "Analyze revenue and payments" and the description is the existing long description. Adds a capabilities list and keywords that describe the six finance sources and the actions the plugin already has (Stripe customer and subscription creation after confirmation; the other sources are read-only). Skills, MCP configuration, long description, starter prompts and review test cases are unchanged from 1.0.0.
